sidequests.title: Chinatown Food Tour
sidequests.description: Eat your way through Boston's Chinatown in one afternoon: dim sum, soup dumplings, then dessert. Every stop is a short walk from the last, and portions are meant for sharing, so come hungry and bring friends.

stops.address: Beach St & Surface Rd, Boston, MA 02111
stops.description: Meet at the gate at the start of Beach Street.
stops.planned_activity: Meet up and take a group photo.
stops.notes: 2 min walk from Chinatown station (Orange Line).

checklist.label: Take a group photo under the gate

stops.description: Big Cantonese dining room for dim sum. Dim sum is served during the day only.
stops.planned_activity: Share a round of dim sum.
stops.notes: About 2 min walk. Arrive before noon on weekends to beat the line.
